description: Files covered by the addon manifest contentHash. Globs are POSIX paths relative to the addon folder: ** matches any number of folders, * and ? stay inside one folder, matching is case-sensitive and dotfiles are not special. Read by the signer (tools/signing/sign-all-addons.mjs) and by the server before every addon import. Changing this file changes every contentHash: re-sign all addons with npm run sign:addons.
